fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and political commentary on Miami and Dade County affairs, including the upcoming city commission election and slates of candidates (Sewell, Platt, Gautier, Reeder, Donn, Aronovitz), criticism of Dade County legislators in Tallahassee, and discussion of Florida Power & Light and public-utility issues. Additional pieces address police summer uniforms, telephone toll charges between Miami and nearby cities, traffic fatalities, Miami Beach policing/curfew complaints, civic cleanup efforts for the Lions convention, transportation notes (Tamiami Trail drive), local society columns ("Little Geraldine"), advertisements, and legal notices including a mortgage foreclosure master’s sale.
